profile.name: Engie SA
profile.summary: Engie SA engages in renewables and decentralized and low-carbon energy networks in France, Europe, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, South America, Africa, and internationally. The Renewables & Flex Power segment comprises renewable energy generation activities, including financing, construction, operation, and maintenance of renewable energy, such as hydroelectric, onshore wind, photovoltaic solar, biomass, offshore wind, geothermal, and battery storage. It also offers flexible thermal generation and electricity, pumping, and battery storage facilities; solutions for decarbonizing industry with low-carbon hydrogen; and operation of desalination plants. The Networks segment comprises the gas and power infrastructure activities, including the management and development of gas and electricity transportation networks and natural gas distribution networks in and outside of Europe, natural gas underground storage, and regasification infrastructure. The Local Energy Infrastructures provides the construction and management of decentralized energy networks, including heating and cooling networks, distributed power generation plants, distributed solar power parks, low-carbon mobility, low-carbon cities and public lighting, energy efficiency, technical maintenance, and sustainable development consulting. The Supply & Energy Management segment optimizes the Group's energy assets, manages market and portfolio risks, and supplies natural gas, green and low-carbon gas, and electricity to residential, business, industrial customers, develops green energy contracts, and digital consumption management. The Other segment manages nuclear power production and holds drawing rights, focusing on operational management, safety, and decommissioning. It offers renewable electricity, green gas, energy management. The company was formerly known as GDF SUEZ S.A. and changed its name to Engie SA in April 2015. Engie SA was founded in 1880 and is based in La Garenne-Colombes, France.
profile.summary_fr: Engie SA s’engage dans les énergies renouvelables et les réseaux énergétiques décentralisés et bas carbone en France, en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Asie, au Moyen-Orient, en Océanie, en Amérique du Sud, en Afrique et à l’international. Le segment Renewables & Flex Power comprend des activités de production d’énergie renouvelable, y compris le financement, la construction, l’exploitation et la maintenance d’énergies renouvelables, telles que l’hydroélectricité, l’éolien terrestre, le solaire photovoltaïque, la biomasse, l’éolien offshore, la géothermie et le stockage de batteries. Il offre également des installations flexibles de production thermique et d'électricité, de pompage et de stockage de batteries; des solutions pour l'industrie de décarbonisation avec de l'hydrogène à faible teneur en carbone; et l'exploitation d'installations de dessalement.
